_comment: ECS Fargate task definition TEMPLATE for TesseraApp. All ${VARIABLE} tokens are filled at deploy time via envsubst (see deploy.yml). Do NOT commit a filled copy — commit this template.

_variables.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID: 12-digit AWS account ID (aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account)
_variables.AIVEN_DB: Aiven MySQL database name — use db3, this app's real database. NOT defaultdb (Aiven's empty auto-created database) and NOT tessera (does not exist): both let the app boot and serve the SPA while failing every sign-in.
_variables.S3_BUCKET: S3 bucket name for profile images, e.g. tessera-app-images
_variables.APP_DOMAIN: Public URL of the app, e.g. https://app.tessera.example.com
_variables._ARN_note: The *_ARN tokens below must be the COMPLETE Secrets Manager ARN, random suffix included (e.g. tessera-app/jwt-secret-AbC123) — a bare name or a hand-built ARN without the suffix is ambiguous to ECS, which then defaults to an SSM Parameter Store lookup instead and fails. Resolve each with: aws secretsmanager describe-secret --secret-id tessera-app/NAME --query ARN --output text
_variables._logging_note: The LOG_LEVEL_* and DEBUG_REPORT entries below are literals, not ${TOKENS} — they are deliberately NOT part of the envsubst contract, so no new export is required and the empty-value guard in RUNBOOK Part D cannot trip on them. They map to application.yml's logging.level block. Raising one requires re-registering the task definition (plain environment values are baked into a revision), then --force-new-deployment. LOG_LEVEL_SECURITY=DEBUG logs the whole Spring Security filter chain per request and is the fastest way to spend the CloudWatch free tier's 5 GB/month ingestion allowance — diagnose with it, then set it back to INFO. DEBUG_REPORT=true prints Spring Boot's auto-configuration report at startup (header: 'CONDITIONS EVALUATION REPORT' — plural), the prod-available substitute for the devtools CONDITION EVALUATION DELTA, since devtools is excluded from the packaged jar and cannot run here. NOTE it is broader than a boot report: Spring Boot's debug mode also switches core loggers to DEBUG, so it adds ~2-3 DEBUG lines per ALB health check indefinitely (~35 MB/month at a 30s interval, ~0.7% of the CloudWatch free tier) on top of the ~930-line one-off report. Verified live on revision 10, 2026-08-02: it printed 'S3ImageStorageService matched', confirming S3 storage activated rather than falling back to local.
_variables._federation_note: A provider's button appears on the login screen ONLY if its CLIENT_ID reaches the container (OAuth2ClientConfig#federatedProviderCatalog skips any provider with a blank id). Microsoft was absent from this template entirely, which is why it shows locally (.env has MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID) and not on ECS. Also register BOTH callback URLs in each provider console — http://localhost:8080/login/oauth2/code/{provider} for start.sh and https://<APP_DOMAIN>/login/oauth2/code/{provider} for ECS; providers accept a list, so one app registration serves both and no code change is needed to switch.
